description: This file contains the Hibernate-specific implementation of the EncounterDAO interface for the OpenMRS project. It provides methods to persist, retrieve, delete, and query Encounter-related objects from the database, utilizing Hibernate ORM features. The class manages database interactions for Encounter, EncounterType, EncounterRole, and related entities, including complex search criteria and retrieval by UUID. It integrates with the OpenMRS domain model to facilitate encounter data access within the core API.

classes.name: HibernateEncounterDAO
classes.description: HibernateSpecific DAO implementation for Encounter data access in OpenMRS. Manages persistence and retrieval of Encounter entities using Hibernate ORM, including complex querying based on search criteria, UUIDs, and related entities.

methods.name: setSessionFactory
methods.description: Sets the Hibernate SessionFactory used for database interactions.

methods.name: saveEncounter
methods.description: Persists or updates an Encounter object in the database.

methods.name: deleteEncounter
methods.description: Deletes an Encounter object from the database.

methods.name: getEncounter
methods.description: Retrieves an Encounter by its ID.

methods.name: getEncountersByPatientId
methods.description: Fetches all non-voided Encounters associated with a specific patient ID, ordered by encounter date descending.

methods.name: getEncounters
methods.description: Performs a detailed search for Encounters matching specified criteria encapsulated in EncounterSearchCriteria.

methods.name: saveEncounterType
methods.description: Saves or updates an EncounterType entity.

methods.name: deleteEncounterType
methods.description: Deletes a specified EncounterType.

methods.name: getEncounterType
methods.description: Retrieve an EncounterType by its ID.

methods.name: getEncounterType
methods.description: Retrieve an EncounterType by its name, excluding retired types.

methods.name: getAllEncounterTypes
methods.description: Returns a list of all EncounterTypes, optionally including retired ones.

methods.name: findEncounterTypes
methods.description: Searches for EncounterTypes matching a name pattern, case-insensitive.

methods.name: getSavedEncounterDatetime
methods.description: Retrieves the saved encounter datetime directly from the database for internal use, using manual flush mode.

methods.name: getEncounterByUuid
methods.description: Fetches an Encounter by its UUID.

methods.name: getEncounterTypeByUuid
methods.description: Fetches an EncounterType by its UUID.

methods.name: getEncounters
methods.description: Searches for encounters matching keyword query, patient ID, with pagination support.

methods.name: getSavedEncounterLocation
methods.description: Retrieves the Location associated with an Encounter from the database using raw SQL.

methods.name: getAllEncounters
methods.description: Retrieves all encounters for a cohort, grouped by patient, with batching parameters.

methods.name: createEncounterPredicates
methods.description: Helper to generate search predicates based on cohort for retrieving encounters.

methods.name: getCountOfEncounters
methods.description: Counts the number of encounters matching a search query and criteria.

methods.name: createEncounterByQueryPredicates
methods.description: Constructs search predicates for querying encounters based on text query, patient ID, and other filters, including full-text match on associated entities.

methods.name: getEncountersByVisit
methods.description: Retrieves encounters associated with a specific visit.

methods.name: saveEncounterRole
methods.description: Saves or updates an EncounterRole.

methods.name: deleteEncounterRole
methods.description: Deletes an EncounterRole.

methods.name: getEncounterRole
methods.description: Fetches an EncounterRole by ID.

methods.name: getEncounterRoleByUuid
methods.description: Fetches an EncounterRole by UUID.

methods.name: getAllEncounterRoles
methods.description: Returns list of all EncounterRoles, including options for retired ones.

methods.name: getEncounterRoleByName
methods.description: Finds EncounterRole by name.

methods.name: getClassByUuid
methods.description: Generic method to fetch domain objects by UUID, utilizing HibernateUtil.

methods.name: getEncountersNotAssignedToAnyVisit
methods.description: Fetches a limited list of encounters for a patient that are not assigned to any visit.

methods.name: getEncountersByVisitsAndPatient
methods.description: Retrieves encounters (and virtual empty visits) for a patient with pagination, including unassigned visit encounters.

methods.name: getEncountersByVisitsAndPatientCount
methods.description: Counts total encounters and visits for a patient matching criteria.

methods.name: createEmptyVisitsByPatientPredicates
methods.description: Creates search predicates for finding empty visits for a patient.

methods.name: createEncountersByPatientPredicates
methods.description: Generates predicates for retrieving encounters related to a specific patient for search functionality.
